costal region bone: A zone of bone organ comprising the region of a rib or costal cartilage that forms part of the bony thoracic wall, extending between the vertebral column posteriorly and the sternum or costal margin anteriorly, and contributing to the structural cage that protects the thoracic viscera and supports respiratory mechanics.
free part of arm bone: A zone of bone organ belonging to the skeleton of the free upper limb, comprising the bones distal to the pectoral girdle — namely the humerus of the arm, the radius and ulna of the forearm, and the bones of the hand — that are not fixed to the axial skeleton and participate in the wide range of movements of the upper extremity.
free part of leg bone: A zone of bone organ belonging to the skeleton of the free lower limb, comprising the bones distal to the pelvic girdle — namely the femur of the thigh, the tibia and fibula of the leg, and the bones of the foot — that are not directly fixed to the axial skeleton and function in weight-bearing, locomotion, and posture.
